text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having showcased the majestic presence of 
an Overlord ever since entering the Senior 
Year, TM Opera O descends upon the 
Takarazuka Kinen paddock.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Facing Narita Top Road and Admire Vega... 
Determined to surpass and outrun them no 
matter what, her fighting spirit was fully 
stoked.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, a new rival emerges. —Meisho 
Doto. Though she has a timid personality, 
the skill that brought her this far is 
undeniably real.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The former Big Three meet once again— 
Having honed their skills together to 
topple the supreme Over the Century, the 
two waited for the race to begin.
